title: Hallador Energy Acquires 460 MW of Siemens Turbines for $350 Million, Accelerating Merom Natural Gas Generation Project
author: Hallador Energy Company
description: Hallador Energy announced the acquisition of approximately 460 MW of Siemens gas turbines and related equipment from Energy World Corporation for $350 million ($760/kW), with an additional $100 million in delivery and refurbishment costs. The equipment, which has never been fired, will support Hallador's proposed Merom natural gas generation project in MISO Zone 6, with revenue generation expected between late 2028 and mid-2029. The acquisition secures critical long-lead equipment in a supply-constrained market and represents over half the estimated total project cost.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company secured critical equipment at an attractive price in a supply-constrained market, meaningfully de-risked the Merom project, expanded its contracted sales book to over $2.1 billion, and is positioned to generate revenue between late 2028 and mid-2029. Management views this as an important advancement toward diversification and growth.

title: Hallador Energy Appoints Barbara Sugg, Former CEO of Southwest Power Pool, to Join Board of Directors
author: Na
description: Hallador Energy Company has appointed Barbara Sugg, former President and CEO of Southwest Power Pool, to its Board of Directors effective January 1, 2026, replacing David Hardie who resigned after 35 years. Sugg brings over three decades of energy industry leadership experience, including expertise in grid operations, transmission initiatives, and renewable energy integration.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced energy industry executive with deep expertise in grid operations, transmission projects, and renewable energy integration strengthens the company's leadership and strategic capabilities. This is presented as a positive development to support the company's long-term growth strategy and asset value maximization.

title: Why Hallador Energy Stock Soared Today
author: Joe Tenebruso
description: Hallador Energy reported strong Q3 financial results, with revenue increasing 40% year-over-year, driven by a surge in coal and electric sales. The company is positioning itself to meet growing electricity demand, particularly from AI data centers.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q3 financial performance with 40% revenue growth, 62% increase in coal sales, 29% jump in electric sales, and net income improving from $1.6 million to $23.9 million. The company is strategically expanding generation capacity to meet AI industry's energy needs.
